Missing terminal seal is incomplete and any primary/late/after-seal failure marker vetoes a positive status.

reviewed_terminal_semantics: Original leases are held through early receipt publication, then every close is attempted before post-cleanup artifact hashing.
Required cleanup evidence is written on successful and already failed attempts. Both primary and late close errors remain independently visible.
Terminal output hashes bind all earlier files; in ordinary completed synthetic fixtures only terminal-seal.json itself is outside the inventory.
A parent deadline crossed during terminal publication creates after-seal-failure.json; source return status becomes failed even if on-disk earlier seal had a pending status.

Post-cleanup/sealing exceptions attempt a separate late supplement with close outcomes without rewriting a primary failure, early receipt or partial artifact. Missing/invalid records remain incomplete; no retry is implied.
